LACAHSA vs TCAC LA 2025 awards

Tract layer (ACS 2020-2024, TCAC 2025 map)

Legend

Project points

Transit (LA Metro GTFS)

Straight-line distance, not walking distance. Bus = Rapid 720/754/761 and G/J lines only (the other Rapid lines are no longer separate in the feed).

Key to reading

Click a point for all project variables; hover a tract for its value ± margin of error (90%). Gray tracts = no estimate (suppressed). Rent/value tracts marked "top-coded" are censored at the ACS ceiling. Points use address-level geocodes only (no ZIP/city centroids).

Group means (SE), n — three groups

N differs by variable. LACAHSA awarded: AMI shares = Round 2 only (10 of 20). Not awarded: units use all applications; neighborhood variables only the geocoded ones; AMI, stories, unit mix not available (N/A). n<30 → wide SEs; differences < ~2 SE are not distinguishable. See Data dictionary & sources.

Geocode quality'address_level' = Census match with agreeing house number, ZIP and LA County; 'address_level_zip_differs' = street/number matched but ZIP in source differs; 'intersection_only' (Walnut Bluff); anything else REVIEW and never filled with ZIP/city centroids.S2All
[Summary rows] n / mean / SEn = non-blank count per group; mean = average; SE = sample SD / sqrt(n) (binomial SE for 1/0 columns).computedIn Crosstab sheets: also 95% t-CI, Welch t and Mann-Whitney p-values, Wilson CIs and Fisher exact p for shares; 'se_acs' = ACS sampling error of the group mean = sqrt(sum SE_i^2)/n. All LACAHSA cells carry an n<30 flag.
